entries.65e86ae6c37d2e8a: As its management philosophy, the company upholds "management of challenge and creation," and makes it its mission to provide customers with "excitement and enjoyable experiences." In its management indicators, it places the greatest importance on MAU (the number of users who log in to a game 1 or more times a month). Its medium- to long-term management strategies are "creation of new revenue pillars" and "establishment of a global brand," and it sets out as priority issues to be addressed the maximization of existing value, challenges to create new value, and growth in global markets.
